{{Season Infobox |background=025DA6 |cellcolor=F16A81 |headcolor=FFFFFF |name=Pokémon the Series: XY |image=Pokémon the Series XY logo.png |size=240px |number=17 |opening=Pokémon Theme#Opening animation: Dub OP 17{{!}}Pokémon Theme (Version XY) |numeps=48 |region=[[Kalos]] |series=''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]'' |prev=Pokémon: BW Adventures in Unova and Beyond |next=Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest }} '''Pokémon the Series: XY''' is the seventeenth [[season]] of the [[dub]]bed version of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It follows the conclusion of the third and final dubbed season of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]'', and as such is the first dubbed season of ''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]''. The season follows {{Ash}} as he continues his {{pkmn|journey}}, venturing in the [[Kalos]] [[region]] and being joined by his new {{AP|friends}} {{an|Clemont}}, {{an|Bonnie}}, and {{an|Serena}}. It debuted with a special showing of its first two episodes on October 19, 2013, following the showing of ''[[M16|Genesect and the Legend Awakened]]'' on {{DL|Pokémon in the United States|Cartoon Network}}. It began on January 18, 2014 with the dub premiere ''[[XY001|Kalos, Where Dreams and Adventures Begin!]]'', and concluded on December 20, 2014 with ''[[XY049|Bonnie for the Defense!]]''. It originally aired in {{pmin|the United States}} as part of the 2014 Cartoon Network Saturday morning lineup. It is preceded by [[S16|Pokémon: BW Adventures in Unova and Beyond]] and succeeded by [[S18|Pokémon the Series XY: Kalos Quest]]. ==Blurb== ''It’s time for Ash and Pikachu to set off on their adventures in the Kalos region! Along the way, they’re joined by some new friends—a genius inventor named Clemont, his little sister Bonnie, and Serena, a Trainer on her first journey. Ash immediately tries to challenge the Gym in Lumiose City, but doesn’t get very far before a robot throws him out! In between Gym battles, Ash and friends will be exploring this unique region, meeting all kinds of new Pokémon, and looking into a fascinating new Pokémon mystery!'' ==Important events== {{spoilers}} [[File:Pokémon the Series XY poster.png|thumb|250px|Poster for the season]] * {{an|Serena}} is introduced. ([[XY001]]) * {{Ash}} arrives in Kalos. ([[XY001]]) * Ash meets {{an|Clemont}} and {{an|Bonnie}}. ([[XY001]]) * Clemont is revealed to own a {{TP|Clemont|Bunnelby}}. ([[XY001]]) * Ash meets {{an|Professor Sycamore}}. ([[XY002]]) * Ash, Clemont, Bonnie, and {{TRT}} learn about [[Mega Evolution]]. ([[XY002]]) * Serena sees Ash on TV and recognizes him from when they were younger. ([[XY002]]) * Serena leaves on her [[Pokémon journey]]. ([[XY003]]) * Ash, Clemont and Bonnie agree to travel together. ([[XY003]]) * Ash registers for the [[Kalos League]]. ([[XY003]]) * Bonnie befriends a {{p|Dedenne}}. ([[XY003]]) * Serena reunites with Ash and meets Clemont and Bonnie for the first time. ([[XY005]]) * Serena officially joins {{ashfr|the gang}} in their travels. ([[XY007]]) * Ash and Serena meet [[Meyer]], Clemont and Bonnie's father. ([[XY009]]) * Ash and Serena learn that Clemont is the ejected [[Gym Leader]] of [[Lumiose Gym]], having been forced to abandon it with Bonnie when [[Clembot]], one of his inventions, ran amok and took over. ([[XY009]]) * Blaziken Mask is revealed to be Meyer, Clemont and Bonnie's father. ([[XY010]]) * Serena and Bonnie learn about Evolution. ([[XY012]]) * Ash learns of the {{t|Fairy}} type. ([[XY013]]) * Ash, his friends, and Team Rocket encounter an evil, psychopathic {{an|Malamar}}. ([[XY019]]) * Ash and his friends visit the [[Battle Chateau]]. ([[XY020]]) * Ash and his friends meet [[Grant]] and learn that he is the [[Cyllage Gym]] Leader. ([[XY020]]) * Ash wins his first Battle Chateau challenge and becomes a {{tc|Baron}}.
